title: Republicans Point Fingers, but Trump Does Not Appear to Be Listening
summary: After last week’s midterm losses, the Republican Party entered its most uncertain moment in years. Some Republicans called for moderation and cleaning house, but that will be difficult with President Trump still in the White House.
